description.p: Deskphone is a native Linux softphone designed for GNOME. Make and receive calls using standard SIP accounts (such as FRITZ!Box or Sipgate), Asterisk / FreePBX servers, and SwyxWare / Enreach office phone systems.
Deskphone ist ein natives Linux-Softphone für GNOME. Telefonieren Sie über Standard-SIP-Konten (wie FRITZ!Box oder Sipgate), Asterisk / FreePBX sowie SwyxWare- und Enreach-Telefonanlagen.

ul.li: Two phone lines with hold, swap, attended merge, and quick call transfers
Call journal with filters, searchable contacts, and voicemail overview
Speed dial sidebar with live colleague status and group call pickup
Optional read-only GNOME Contacts & Online Accounts sync and safe tel: link handling
Secure password storage in your system keyring and background call notifications

description.p: Initial GNOME release featuring pure-Rust SIP/RTP telephony, multi-provider support (Standard SIP, SwyxWare, Asterisk), Libadwaita adaptive two-column UI, and GNOME Keyring integration.
